name: AdCP 3.2 Signature-Input sig-param string value sent unquoted (keyid=foo instead of keyid="foo", content-digest covered)
spec_reference: #verifier-checklist-requests step 1 (RFC 9421 §2.3 sig-params; RFC 8941 §3.3 string values MUST be double-quoted); AdCP 3.2 profile per #content-digest-and-proxy-compatibility and #adcp-rfc-9421-profile binary value encoding
$comment: 3.2-profile counterpart of negative/024-unquoted-string-param.json. AdCP 3.2 profile: the signature covers content-digest, binary values use RFC 8941 sf-binary (standard padded Base64), and the verifier advertises covers_content_digest='required'. The Signature is a valid Ed25519 signature over expected_signature_base, which carries the sig-params exactly as sent (unquoted keyid), so the unquoted string is the only fault.
